# Dear Doctor

> Dear Doctor is a trusted patient education resource providing comprehensive dentistry and oral health information through magazines, videos, and professional practice marketing materials.

Dear Doctor serves both patients seeking reliable dental health information and dental practices looking for patient education solutions. The platform partners with major professional dental organizations including the American Academy of Cosmetic Dentistry, American Association of Endodontists, and American Academy of Periodontology to deliver evidence-based content.

## Key Topics

- Patient Education
- Dental Implants
- Cosmetic Dentistry
- Gum Disease
- Tooth Replacement
- Dental Trauma
- Oral Health
- Cavity Prevention
- Orthodontic Treatment
- Emergency Dental Care
- Smile Makeover
- Dental Videos
- Periodontal Health
- Tooth Decay
- Dental Magazine

## Core Resources

- [Home - Dentist, Dentistry & Oral Health Guide](https://www.deardoctor.com): Leading source for trustworthy dentistry and oral health information including implants, cosmetic procedures, and prevention.
- [Dear Doctor Magazine](https://www.deardoctor.com/dental-magazine): Quarterly patient education dental magazine covering cosmetic, endodontic, and periodontic topics.
- [Dental Videos Library](https://www.deardoctor.com/dental-videos): Video library of dental and oral health educational content for patients and professionals.
- [About Dear Doctor](https://www.deardoctor.com/about-dear-doctor): Company overview describing Dear Doctor's mission, founders, and partnerships with professional dental organizations.

## Practice Marketing & Education Products

- [Patient Education Products for Dental Practices](https://www.deardoctor.com/dental-marketing): Suite of patient education products for dental practices including videos, website content, and waiting room materials.

## Dental Health & Treatment Guides

- [What Everyone Should Know About Tooth Decay](https://www.deardoctor.com/articles/what-everyone-should-know-about-tooth-decay): Educational article on tooth decay causes, prevention, and risk factors.
- [When a Tooth Is Knocked Out](https://www.deardoctor.com/inside-the-magazine/issue-39/when-a-tooth-is-knocked-out): Emergency guide for tooth replantation and first aid for knocked-out teeth.
- [Dental Injuries - Field-Side Guide](https://www.deardoctor.com/dental-injuries): Pocket guide for managing dental injuries for parents, trainers, caregivers, and patients.
- [When Permanent Teeth Become Loose](https://www.deardoctor.com/articles/when-permanent-teeth-become-loose): Guide to causes of loose teeth including gum disease and treatment options.
- [Replacing All Teeth But Not All At Once](https://www.deardoctor.com/articles/replacing-all-teeth-but-not-all-at-once): Guide to gradual tooth replacement options and cost-effective implant strategies.
- [Dry Socket - Post-Operative Complication Guide](https://www.deardoctor.com/inside-the-magazine/issue-39/dry-socket): Educational article on dry socket complications and post-operative care.
- [Removing Teeth for Orthodontic Treatment](https://www.deardoctor.com/articles/removing-teeth-for-orthodontic-treatment): Article on tooth extraction necessity in orthodontic treatment planning.
- [Holistic Dentistry - Evidence-Based Practices](https://www.deardoctor.com/articles/holistic-dentistry): Article examining holistic dentistry practices and evidence-based approaches.
- [Vaping and Oral Health](https://www.deardoctor.com/inside-the-magazine/issue-39/vaping-and-oral-health): Article examining vaping's negative effects on oral health and gum disease.
